original.text: snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams kun/ /rang rig sems ni gud na med/ /snang zhing gsal ba yin pa'i phyir/ /dper na rang rig nyams myong bzhin/ /gal te sems de ma yin na/ /'brel pa med phyir mi snang thal/ /de ltar kun rdzob gtan la dbab/ /chos kun sems la gnas zhes gsungs/
original.edition: Derge Tengyur (sde dge bstan 'gyur), digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling, Tōh 2304; Wylie by the unit (pyewts)
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: All phenomena of appearance and existence are not other than self-aware mind, because they appear and are clear, like one's own experience of self-awareness; if they were not mind, being unrelated (to it) they would not appear. Thus the conventional is established: 'all phenomena abide in mind', it is said.
speaker: Nāropa
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (Sanskrit/Apabhraṃśa original not extant or not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: chos kyi dngos gzhi sems nyid de/ /rig pa bzhi sogs kyis dpyad kyang / /dngos po sgra yi cha tsam med/ /dper na nam mkha'i pad+ma bzhin/ /de ltar yod pa ma grub phyir/ /med pa cung zad grub mi 'gyur/ /phan tshun ltos pa nyid kyi phyir/ /tshu rol ma grub pha rol bzhin/ /yod med gnyis ka ma yin te/ /so so nyid du bkag phyir ro/ /gnyis ka med pa ma yin te/ /yod med dngos su 'gal ba'i phyir/ /lus can yang ni ma yin la/ /lus can min pa mi srid phyir/ /des na spros pa thams cad bral/ /de ltar don dam gtan la dbab/ /sems ni nam mkha' la gnas gsungs/
original.edition: Derge Tengyur (sde dge bstan 'gyur), digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling, Tōh 2304; Wylie by the unit (pyewts)
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: The basis of phenomena is mind itself; examined by the four reasonings and the like, not even a sound-part of a thing (is found), like a sky-flower. Since existence is not established, not the least non-existence is established either, for they are mutually dependent, like this shore and the other. It is not both existence and non-existence, since each is refuted; not neither, since existence and non-existence directly exclude each other; not embodied, and not non-embodied either; therefore free of all elaborations. Thus the ultimate is established: 'mind abides in space', it is said.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (Sanskrit/Apabhraṃśa original not extant or not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: rang rig spros bral de nyid kyang / /snang zhing stong la stong zhing snang / /de phyir snang stong dbyer med de/ /dper na chu yi zla ba bzhin/ /de ltar gnyis med gtan la dbab/ /nam mkha' ci la'ang mi gnas gsungs/ /rang bzhin spros bral de nyid ni/ /rig pa yin phyir gsal ba'o/ /rang rig min phyir mi rtog ste/ /rang rig rang la rtog mi srid/ /rnam par rtog bya min pa'i phyir/ /sems de'i rang bzhin mi rtog nyid/ /gsal ba mi rtog ye shes te/ /dper na bde gshegs ye shes bzhin/ /des na sems nyid 'od gsal la/ /sems ni ye shes yin rtogs na/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du mi btsal gsungs/
original.edition: Derge Tengyur (sde dge bstan 'gyur), digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling, Tōh 2304; Wylie by the unit (pyewts)
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: That self-awareness free of elaboration appears and is empty, is empty and appears; therefore appearance and emptiness are inseparable, like the moon in water. Thus non-duality is established: 'space abides in nothing', it is said. That nature free of elaboration is clear because it is awareness, and non-conceptual because self-awareness cannot conceptualize itself — clear, non-conceptual wisdom, like the wisdom of the sugatas. Therefore, if one realizes mind itself as clear light and mind as wisdom, one does not seek the buddha elsewhere.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (Sanskrit/Apabhraṃśa original not extant or not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: 'on kyang sems de glo bur gyi/ /rnam rtog dri mas nyon mongs te/ /chu dang gser dang nam mkha' ltar/ /gnas skabs dag dang ma dag gnyis/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal sems de dang / /glo bur rnam rtog dri ma gnyis/ /gcig gam tha dad gang yin pa/ /shin tu zab pa chen po nyid/ /shin tu zab phyir mkhas pas dpyod/ /bshad pa yod kyang ma bris so/
original.edition: Derge Tengyur (sde dge bstan 'gyur), digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling, Tōh 2304; Wylie by the unit (pyewts)
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: Yet that mind is afflicted by the adventitious stains of thought; like water, gold and space it has two conditions, pure and impure. Whether the naturally luminous mind and the adventitious stains of thought are one or different is extremely profound; because it is so profound the wise examine it — there is an explanation, but it is not written down.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (Sanskrit/Apabhraṃśa original not extant or not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: stong pa de nyid rig pa sems/ /byang chub sems kyang de nyid do/ /sangs rgyas rigs kyang de nyid yin/ /bde gshegs snying po de nyid de/ /ji bzhin pa yi ro myang bas/ /bde ba chen po'ang de nyid yin/ /gsang sngags zhes pa 'di nyid do/ /thabs dang shes rab de nyid la/ /zab dang rgya che de nyid yin/ /kun bzang yab yum de nyid do/ /nang stong dbyings dang ye shes las/ /ye sangs rgya zhes de la bya/ / dri ma dang bcas rang rig de/ /de yang gzhan la mi ltos phyir/ /rang byung ye shes de nyid do/ /'khor ba'i dngos gzhi de nyid de/ /mya ngan 'das pa'ang de nyid yin/ /dbu ma chen mo'ang de nyid do/ /mthong bar bya ba de nyid do/ /bsgom par bya ba'ang de nyid do/ /thob par bya ba'ang de nyid do/ /tshad ma'i bden pa'ang de nyid yin/ /rgyu dang thabs dang 'bras bu yi/ /rgyud ni rnam gsum grags pa dang / /gzhi lam 'bras bur grags pa dang / /de nyid kyi ni gnas skabs so/ /rgyu rkyen rtsa ba kun gzhi dang / /'khor ba ji srid phung po dang / / gzhan dbang shes pa la sogs grags/
original.edition: Derge Tengyur (sde dge bstan 'gyur), digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling, Tōh 2304; Wylie by the unit (pyewts)
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: That emptiness, awareness, mind is also bodhicitta, the buddha-family, the sugatagarbha; tasting it as it is, it is great bliss; it is what is called secret mantra; it is method and wisdom, the profound and the vast, Samantabhadra father-mother; from the inner emptiness, the expanse and wisdom, it is called 'primordially awakened'. Self-awareness with stains, not depending on another, is self-arisen wisdom; it is the basis of saṃsāra and also nirvāṇa, the great Madhyamaka, what is to be seen, meditated and attained, the truth of valid cognition; it is known as the three tantras of cause, method and fruit and as ground, path and fruit; its situations are known as the causal root, the ālaya, the aggregates of saṃsāra, the dependent nature and so on.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (Sanskrit/Apabhraṃśa original not extant or not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: sems nyid dri ma dang bcas de/ /rnam 'phrul 'gro ba drug la sogs/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' klas par/ /sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor bsam las 'das/ /rnam rtog dri ma dang bral ba'i/ /rang rig spros bral de nyid ni/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'ang de nyid yin/ /sangs rgyas drug pa'ang de nyid do/ /rigs drug pa'ang de nyid do/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu'ang de nyid yin/ /rnam par snang mdzad de yin te/ /chos kyi sku dang bde chen dang / /zung 'jug ces pa de nyid do/ /bzhi pa'i dbang yang de yin te/ /lhan cig skyes dga' de nyid do/ /rang bzhin dag pa'ang de nyid la/ /de la sogs pa mdo rgyud las/ /rnam grangs tha snyad grags pa rnams/ /phal cher de la brten pa yin/ /ji ltar rigs par sbyar bar bya/
original.edition: Derge Tengyur (sde dge bstan 'gyur), digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling, Tōh 2304; Wylie by the unit (pyewts)
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: E ma ho! Mind itself with stains is the magical display of the six classes of beings, an inconceivable machinery of suffering as boundless as space. That self-awareness free of the stains of thought and of elaboration is non-abiding nirvāṇa; it is Vajrasattva, the sixth buddha, the sixth family, youthful Mañjuśrī, Vairocana; it is dharmakāya, great bliss and union; it is the fourth empowerment and co-emergent joy; it is natural purity — most of the synonyms known in sūtras and tantras rest on it and should be applied accordingly.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (Sanskrit/Apabhraṃśa original not extant or not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: rang sems de la rmongs pa yi/ /phyi rol mu stegs pa dag gis/ /bdag dang gtso bo la sogs zhes/ /grub mtha' log pa'i rgya mtshor zhugs/ /rang gi sde pa nyan thos dang / /rang rgyal sems tsam pa dag gis/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis su 'dzin pa dang / /gnyis med yang dag nyid du rtogs/ /gzhan yang rnam bden rnam rdzun sogs/ /rnam rtog dra bar tshud par 'gyur/
original.edition: Derge Tengyur (sde dge bstan 'gyur), digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling, Tōh 2304; Wylie by the unit (pyewts)
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: Deluded about their own mind, outer tīrthikas speak of a self, a primordial nature and the like and enter an ocean of wrong tenets; within our own schools, śrāvakas, pratyekabuddhas and mind-only followers grasp at the duality of apprehended and apprehender or take non-duality as truly real; others fall into the net of thought as 'true aspect' and 'false aspect' (proponents).
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (Sanskrit/Apabhraṃśa original not extant or not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: de ltar lta ba ma nor na/ /bsgom pa dang ni spyod pa dag /dngos dang mthun pas byang chub thob/ /dkyus bstan pa yi rta bzhin no/ /lta ba dngos dang ma mthun na/ /bsgom dang spyod pa 'khrul 'gyur bas/ / 'bras bu ji bzhin mi 'thob ste/ /dmus long dmigs bu med pa bzhin/
original.edition: Derge Tengyur (sde dge bstan 'gyur), digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling, Tōh 2304; Wylie by the unit (pyewts)

paraphrase: If the view is not mistaken, meditation and conduct accord with reality and awakening is attained, like a horse on a track that has been shown; if the view does not accord with reality, meditation and conduct go astray and the fruit is not attained as it is, like a blind man without a guide.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (Sanskrit/Apabhraṃśa original not extant or not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan
